fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5% of Gross Revenues, paid weekly via Electronic Depository Transfer Account. Advertising Fund Contribution is currently 2% of Gross Revenues (up to 3% maximum), paid weekly. Local Advertising Requirement is at least 3% of Gross Revenues weekly; franchisee may be required to pay some or all to franchisor for local marketing. Advertising Cooperative contribution is proportionate share (currently no cooperatives exist). Holdover period fees are 150% of the Royalty Fee and Advertising Fund contributions. Management Fee is currently $500/day for up to 60 days plus expenses. No required capital expenditures during first two years of operations.
